tasks.title: Finish Continuity site
tasks.required_relation: continue A/B until the site's actually required relations close

inputs.rule: Use A/B to discover the next required relation. Enter only the layer reached by that relation, resolve that layer's native reference, implement/test the supported movement, then feed the returned state back into A/B.

expected_output.closed_relations: list of witnessed site relations closed
expected_output.evidence: tests / runtime checks / visual witnesses / provenance

boundaries: Do not turn finish into a fixed frontend/backend/auth/database/API/settings/billing checklist.
Do not add a component merely because common apps have one.
Use build/Complete Stack only to expose required dependencies; use the native reference of each reached layer before invention.
Do not declare visual completion in place of behavioral/evidence closure.
For WALL/UNKNOWN, run the outward native-reference pass first; only after that and agent-pool exhaustion may the same unresolved wall reach the James task bridge.
tasks.notes: This task is recursive. A supported result becomes the next A/B input until the site reaches evidence closure or an explicit wall.

tasks.title: Find things to swallow
tasks.required_relation: find external/native systems whose movement Continuity can traverse without absorbing their owned state

inputs.boundary_role: swallow-first resolver for WALL/UNKNOWN before later reground or human escalation
inputs.meaning_of_swallow: Find useful systems, sources, protocols, tools, data surfaces, workflows, or physical/process layers that Continuity can enter in their own shape, preserve provenance through, and connect to the existing A/B/reference/handoff stack.
inputs.selection_rule: Prefer things with observable movement, a native witness surface, an inspectable contract/interface, and a clear return relation.

expected_output.candidates: ranked candidate referents with native sources/interfaces
expected_output.why_useful: what new movement/reference/dependency each candidate exposes
expected_output.connection_path: how Continuity can traverse it without claiming ownership
expected_output.reference_kind: existing kind or evidence needed for a new admitted native reference
expected_output.next_ab: smallest test that would determine whether to connect it

boundaries: Swallow means traverse/connect, not copy the external system into Continuity.
Do not prefer a candidate just because it is popular or easy to categorize.
Do not create a new reference adapter until a real native witness contract is inspected.
Do not treat discovery snippets as proof.
Keep source ownership, native terminology, and provenance intact.
tasks.notes: This is the expansion task. Its useful output is new traversable movement and native reference evidence, not a long catalog.

tasks.title: Visual provenance min/max
tasks.required_relation: A/B visual density and reference fit until more useful state fits without losing readability, provenance, or native relations

inputs.instruction: min/max the visual provenance until everything that should fit fits and the page visually closes
minimize: scroll required before current movement becomes readable
maximize: useful witnessed movement visible per viewport
inputs.loop_rule: Make one visual relation change at a time, compare before/after against the active visual reference and local binding, keep only improvements, and feed the surviving visual state back into A/B.

expected_output.result: visual closure / wall / next measurable edge
expected_output.before_after: viewport/render measurements and screenshots where available
expected_output.rejected_changes: ideas collapsed or made fit/readability/provenance worse

required_witnesses: min/max changes compared before and after
boundaries: Do not optimize for prettiness alone; optimize the witnessed visual relation.
Do not copy branding/trade dress from external visual witnesses.
Do not re-add inert controls merely to match a reference.
Do not hide source/provenance to gain density.
Do not declare closure without checking both desktop and mobile.
If another relation is required to make the visual surface honest, open that layer instead of faking the visual.
tasks.notes: This is iterative visual A/B, not a one-shot redesign. Stop when further changes collapse, regress another witnessed relation, or hit a measurable wall.
